BiblicalUsage: Seth is the son given to Adam and Eve in the place of Abel, and his son Enos is the first to call upon the name of the LORD. His line runs through the genealogies to Noah, and the Chronicler begins the history of Israel with his name.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Seth is the seed God appointed when the first seed was murdered, and his line is the line of the promise. I hold that the God who gives a son after Abel is the God who gives a Saviour after the fall.
